name: 极繁巴洛克
description: 米金 #F5ECD7 + 深酒红 #6B1B2E + 金色 #B8860B 三色奢华风。H1 上下 double 金双线包裹+居中、H2 上下单金线+居中、H3 italic 金色居中、blockquote 上下金线+居中斜体+超大引号感、hr double 金线。所有元素全居中 italic 装饰。适合文艺评论/书评/复古怀旧/深度散文。

styles.container: background-color: #F5ECD7; font-family: 'Baskerville','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Playfair Display',serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; color: #6B1B2E; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 28px; border-top: 3px double #B8860B; border-bottom: 3px double #B8860B; letter-spacing: 4px; font-style: italic;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #6B1B2E; text-align: center; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-top: 1px solid #B8860B; border-bottom: 1px solid #B8860B; letter-spacing: 3px;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #B8860B; text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px;
styles.h4: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #6B1B2E; text-align: center; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #6A4A2A; text-align: center; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #8A7659; text-align: center; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #3A2E1F; line-height: 1.95; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: font-size: 18px; color: #6B1B2E; line-height: 1.9; text-align: center; font-style: italic; border-top: 2px solid #B8860B; border-bottom: 2px solid #B8860B; background: transparent; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 18px; color: #6B1B2E; line-height: 1.9; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 1px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 2px; display: block; border: 2px solid #B8860B; background: transparent; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 36px; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 3px double #B8860B; width: 50%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.code: background: transparent; border: 1px solid #B8860B; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 92%; color: #6B1B2E; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace; font-style: italic;
styles.pre: background: #FAF3E2; border: 2px double #B8860B; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #3A2E1F; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #EDE0C6; color: #6B1B2E; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; font-style: italic;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #3A2E1F; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; border: 2px double #B8860B;
styles.th: text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: #6B1B2E; background: #EDE0C6; border-bottom: 2px double #B8860B; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.td: border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(184,134,11,0.3); color: #3A2E1F; text-align: center;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #3A2E1F; line-height: 1.95; letter-spacing: 0.4px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; color: #6B1B2E; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #6A4A2A; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
